raw_segments.text: Gymnastic as well as music should begin in early years, the training in it should be
careful and should continue through life.
Now my belief is, and this is a matter upon which I should like to have your opinion in
confirmation of my own, but my own belief is, not that the good body by any bodily excellence
improves the soul, but on the contrary, that the good soul, by her own excellence, improves
the body as far as this may be possible.
